t: Versions of William's air in scene XI
d: Coffee shop. Ferrando, Guglielmo and Don Alfonso.
Garden on the beach of the sea. Fiordiligi and Dorabella look at a portrait that hangs on their side.

Don Alfonso solo; then Despina.

Ferrando and Guglielmo with band of Players and choir of Marinai - Singers and Singers - in the boat; Despina in the garden; Fiordiligi and Dorabella, accompanied by Don Alfonso, come on the side; Servi richly dressed.

Fiordiligi, then Ferrando. William and Don Alfonso in the other room.
William and Don Alfonso; then Ferrando.
Ferrando, William, Don Alfonso and Despina.
Fully lit room. Orchestra at the end. Table for four people, with silver dowels etc. Despina, servants, servants and players; then Don Alfonso.
Fiordiligi, Dorabella, Ferrando, Guglielmo, Servi and Players.
